hand.name: The Hand
hand.blurb: Thirty years on this ground. Slow, hard to move, and not especially worried.

passive.desc: Standing still 1s grants +6% damage reduction per second to 30%. Resets on move.

ability.name: Dig In
ability.desc: Immovable, 70% damage reduction, ends in a 140px knockback pulse.

hand.cardPassive: Braced — standing still stacks damage reduction to 30%.

kid.name: The Kid
kid.blurb: Home from school for the summer. Only ever safe at speed; stopping is the mistake.

passive.desc: +1% damage per 2% of max velocity, to +50%. Zero when standing.

ability.name: Bolt
ability.desc: Dash with i-frames, leaving a dust trail that blinds pursuers 2s.

kid.cardPassive: Momentum — up to +50% damage at full speed, nothing standing.

_abilityNote: Four classes share the two implemented ability archetypes - `digIn` (plant and absorb) and `bolt` (dash with i-frames) - retuned per class rather than each getting a bespoke one. That is a deliberate first pass: a class with a borrowed ability is fully playable, a class with an unimplemented ability id has a button that silently does nothing. Bespoke abilities are follow-up work, and the place to add them is the `a.id ===` dispatch in world.ts and player.ts.

widow.name: The Widow
widow.blurb: Buried a husband and a harvest the same autumn. Nothing out here frightens her.

passive.desc: Standing still 1s grants +4% damage reduction per second to 24%. Resets on move.

ability.name: Hold the Line
ability.desc: Immovable, 55% damage reduction, ends in a 170px knockback pulse.

widow.cardPassive: Braced — a shorter fuse than the Hand, a lower ceiling.

vet.name: The Veteran
vet.blurb: Came home, took the back forty, and kept the habit of watching treelines.

passive.desc: Standing still 1s grants +3% damage reduction per second to 18%. Resets on move.

ability.name: Break Contact
ability.desc: Dash with long i-frames, blinding pursuers 2.5s.

vet.cardPassive: Braced — crit-leaning, holds ground well enough.

agronomist.name: The Agronomist
agronomist.blurb: Sent out to test the soil. Stayed once she worked out what was in it.

passive.desc: +1% damage per 3% of max velocity, to +30%. Zero when standing.

ability.name: Field Sample
ability.desc: Dash with i-frames, leaving a blinding cloud for 3s.

agronomist.cardPassive: Momentum — modest, and +35% off every node she works.

drifter.name: The Drifter
drifter.blurb: Works a season, moves on. This season he did not get out in time.

passive.desc: +1% damage per 1.6% of max velocity, to +60%. Zero when standing.

ability.name: Light Out
ability.desc: A long dash with i-frames, blinding pursuers 1.5s.

drifter.cardPassive: Momentum — up to +60%, and nothing at all when standing.

_cardNote: `tag`, `bars` and `cardPassive` are the class card's presentation, from the design's Home Screen mockup. Bars are 0-100 for the BODY/SPEED/REACH meters and are a READ of the class rather than a derivation from its stats -- Reach has no single stat behind it, and a computed bar would fight the design's intent every time balance moved.
